name: Computer Certified Professional (CCP)
description: Professional computing certification covering computer fundamentals, hardware, operating systems, networking, cybersecurity, and modern IT practices.

modules.name: Computer Fundamentals
modules.description: Discover what makes a computer tick — hardware, software, and how they work together to solve problems.
learningObjectives: Identify the main components of a computer system
Explain the difference between hardware and software
Describe the information processing cycle (input → process → output → storage)
Recognize common input and output devices

modules.name: Hardware Basics
modules.description: Explore the physical parts of a computer — from motherboards to peripherals — and what each one does.
learningObjectives: Identify the internal components of a computer
Explain the role of the motherboard and its connections
Compare different types of storage (HDD, SSD, NVMe)
Understand how peripherals connect (USB, Bluetooth, HDMI)

modules.name: CPU & Memory
modules.description: Learn how processors execute billions of instructions per second and how memory stores data temporarily.
learningObjectives: Explain the fetch-decode-execute cycle
Differentiate between RAM, ROM, and cache memory
Understand clock speed, cores, and hyperthreading
Compare x86 and ARM architectures

modules.name: Storage & File Systems
modules.description: Understand how data persists — from spinning disks to SSDs — and how operating systems organize files.
learningObjectives: Compare HDD, SSD, and NVMe storage technologies
Explain how file systems organize data (FAT32, NTFS, ext4)
Understand partitions and disk management
Implement a basic backup strategy (3-2-1 rule)

modules.name: Operating Systems
modules.description: Explore Windows, macOS, and Linux — how they manage hardware, run apps, and give you a usable interface.
learningObjectives: Explain the role of the OS kernel
Describe how processes and threads are managed
Understand file permissions and user accounts
Use basic command-line tools (cd, ls, mkdir, etc.)

modules.name: Networking Basics
modules.description: How computers talk to each other — IP addresses, routers, switches, and the layers of network communication.
learningObjectives: Explain the OSI 7-layer model
Understand IP addressing (IPv4 and IPv6)
Describe how DNS resolves domain names
Differentiate between routers, switches, and hubs

modules.name: Internet & Web Technology
modules.description: How the web works — HTTP, browsers, servers, and the technologies that power the modern internet.
learningObjectives: Explain how HTTP requests and responses work
Understand the role of DNS, servers, and CDNs
Describe cookies, sessions, and browser storage
Recognize what APIs are and how they power modern apps

modules.name: Databases Fundamentals
modules.description: How applications store and retrieve data — relational databases, SQL, and modern NoSQL systems.
learningObjectives: Explain tables, rows, columns, and relationships
Write basic SQL queries (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
Understand when to use SQL vs NoSQL
Recognize the importance of indexes and backups

modules.name: Cybersecurity Basics
modules.description: Protect systems and data from threats — passwords, encryption, malware, and security best practices.
learningObjectives: Identify common cyber threats (phishing, malware, ransomware)
Explain encryption basics (symmetric, asymmetric, hashing)
Understand MFA and password best practices
Describe the role of firewalls and antivirus

modules.name: Cloud Computing Intro
modules.description: Learn how AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud deliver computing as a service — IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and beyond.
learningObjectives: Differentiate IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
Explain virtualization and containers
Understand core AWS/Azure/GCP services
Recognize when serverless makes sense

modules.name: Software Development Basics
modules.description: How software gets built — programming languages, version control, testing, and the dev lifecycle.
learningObjectives: Compare popular programming languages and their uses
Use Git for version control (commit, push, pull, branch)
Explain the software development lifecycle
Describe unit testing and debugging strategies

modules.name: IT Support & Troubleshooting
modules.description: Diagnose and fix common IT problems — a systematic approach to helping users and maintaining systems.
learningObjectives: Apply a systematic troubleshooting methodology
Use ticketing systems to track and resolve issues
Provide effective remote support
Document solutions for future reference

modules.name: Data Privacy & Ethics
modules.description: Handle data responsibly — privacy laws, user consent, ethical AI, and protecting personal information.
learningObjectives: Explain key data privacy regulations (GDPR, POPIA)
Understand user consent and data handling principles
Recognize ethical concerns in AI and automation
Apply data anonymization techniques

modules.name: Emerging Technologies
modules.description: Explore the future — AI, IoT, blockchain, quantum computing, and how they'll reshape IT.
learningObjectives: Explain the basics of AI and machine learning
Describe IoT architecture and use cases
Understand how blockchain works and its applications
Recognize the potential of quantum computing and AR/VR

modules.name: Career Readiness & Interview Prep
modules.description: Turn your CCP certification into a career — CVs, interviews, portfolios, and professional growth.
learningObjectives: Build an IT-focused CV and cover letter
Prepare for technical and behavioral interviews
Create a portfolio showcasing your skills
Use LinkedIn and networking to find opportunities

learningOutcomes: Understand computer hardware, software, and operating systems
Identify and mitigate common cybersecurity threats
Explain cloud, AI, and emerging technologies
Build a professional IT career foundation
longDescription: The CCP certification is a comprehensive 15-module program covering the full spectrum of modern computing — from hardware fundamentals to cybersecurity, cloud, AI, and career readiness. Complete all modules and pass the final exam to earn your globally-recognized CCP credential.
